parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the event. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss and does not include a time zone identifier.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the next query.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the event. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss and does not include a time zone identifier.
